name: AutoCert
overview: Automatic HTTPS certificates with GoDaddy, Cloudflare, or DigitalOcean DNS verification.
description: Obtain and renew Let's Encrypt certificates, generate password-protected PFX files, and update Jellyfin HTTPS settings. Supports GoDaddy API key/secret or PAT. Includes automatic five-day cleanup of replaced AutoCert certificates.

versions.changelog: Adds Issue new certificate now, bypassing the renewal window and disabled automation while retaining the six-hour cooldown.
Adds certificate Issued date and a GitHub repository link on the configuration page.
Shows Certificate expired when the saved certificate expires, including with automatic management disabled. Preserves renewal errors.
Stable release. Automatically removes unused AutoCert certificates after five days with the replacement active; protects current certificates and expires deleted rollback entries.
Removes duplicate Certificate Active text while preserving distinct activity and error messages.
Shows Certificate Active after restart when HTTPS and valid AutoCert certificate settings match. Preserves staging results and renewal errors.
Adds GoDaddy classic API key and secret authentication. Includes automatic renewal, PFX password rotation, optional restart, and rollback.
